precedence.title: How auto-add and tag rules interact
precedence.intro: When a member joins or their Telegram tag changes, rules are evaluated in this order:
precedence.step1: Auto-add: newcomers are subscribed to the lists you selected above.
precedence.step2: Tag rules: AUTO_ADD and AUTO_REMOVE rules from each list's Routing dialog are applied based on the user's current Telegram tag.
precedence.hint: Tag rules always run last, so they take precedence over auto-add. On first join the user usually has no tag yet, tag rules only kick in once an admin assigns one in Telegram.

ex1.title: Newcomer with no tag
ex1.body: User joins, gets subscribed to your default lists (auto-add). No tag rules apply yet. When an admin later tags them "verified", any AUTO_REMOVE rule for "verified" will unsubscribe them from the matching lists.

ex2.title: Existing member tagged as "vip"
ex2.body: Admin sets tag "vip". Every list whose Routing has AUTO_ADD = vip subscribes the user; every list whose Routing has AUTO_REMOVE = vip unsubscribes them. The legacy auto-add list is not re-applied.

ex3.title: Tag removed
ex3.body: Admin clears the tag "vip". The previous AUTO_ADD subscriptions tied to "vip" are undone (user is unsubscribed); AUTO_REMOVE side effects are reversed (user is re-subscribed). The final state is as if the tag had never been set.

rules.dialogDesc: Filter and route members of this list based on their Telegram tag.

EXCLUDE.title: Exclude users tagged…
EXCLUDE.desc: Members with any of these tags will never be mentioned.

INCLUDE_ONLY.title: Include only users tagged…
INCLUDE_ONLY.desc: When set, only members with at least one of these tags get mentioned.

AUTO_ADD.title: Auto-subscribe when user gets tag…
AUTO_ADD.desc: When a user receives one of these tags, they are added to this list.

AUTO_REMOVE.title: Auto-unsubscribe when user gets tag…
AUTO_REMOVE.desc: When a user receives one of these tags, they are removed from this list.
